methods.label: Compare the five sums
methods.explanation:
Compute each sum, keeping the negative signs and using a common denominator where needed:
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{A: }&\frac12+\frac13+\frac16=\frac{3+2+1}{6}=1,\\
\text{B: }&2+(-2)+1=0+1=1,\\
\text{C: }&0.1+0.3+0.6=0.4+0.6=1,\\
\text{D: }&1.1+(-2.1)+1.0=-1+1=0,\\
\text{E: }&-\frac32-\frac52+5=-4+5=1.
\end{aligned}
\]
Only the triplet in \(\boxed{\text{D}}\) has a sum different from \(1\).
